items.raw_excerpt: The Portuguese drone maker Tekever is seeking to raise 500 million euros from investors in a deal that would value the company at 5.5 billion euros.
items.summary_en: Tekever, a drone manufacturer based in Portugal, is looking for 500 million euros from investors. The deal would value the company at 5.5 billion euros. Tekever builds drones for security and defence use.

items.raw_excerpt: A teepee cover was stolen from Kawacatoose First Nation in 1926 and housed at the Smithsonian Institution in Washington, D.C., for a century. It will now finally return to the original owner's descendants.
items.summary_en: A teepee cover taken from Kawacatoose First Nation in 1926 was held at the Smithsonian Institution for a century. The artifact is now being returned to the family descendants in Saskatchewan. The repatriation marks a long-awaited homecoming for an important cultural item.
items.summary_ko: 1926년 카와카투즈 원주민 부족에서 도난당한 텐트피 커버가 100년간 스미스소니언 박물관에 보관되어 있었다. 이 문화 유물은 현재 사스캐처원에 있는 원래 주인의 후손에게 반환되고 있다. 이번 반환은 오랫동안 기다려온 중요한 문화재의 귀향을 의미한다.
items.title_en: Stolen teepee cover returns home after 100 years
items.title_ko: 100년 전 도난 텐트피 커버, 고향으로 돌아오다
items.title_original: Teepee cover stolen 100 years ago finally being repatriated to Sask.

items.summary_en: CD Valdivia closed out a flawless regular season in Chile's Liga Nacional de Básquetbol. The team from the Calle-Calle region secured its spot in the Big 8 and earned home-court advantage in the upcoming play-in round.

items.raw_excerpt: Tenista brasileiro sentiu desconforto durante treino na última segunda-feira (17). Agora ele terá pouco mais de uma semana para se recuperar e treinar antes da estreia no US Open, quarto e último Grand Slam do ano, que começa em 30 de agosto.
items.summary_en: Brazilian tennis player Joao Fonseca felt discomfort during practice on Monday. He now has just over a week to recover before the US Open starts on August 30. He withdrew from the Cincinnati Masters to focus on getting fit for the final Grand Slam of the year.

items.raw_excerpt: While the life expectancy of Indigenous people in remote communities has improved, Aboriginal health groups are telling the federal and Northern Territory governments a lot more work is still needed to close the gap.
items.summary_en: Indigenous people in remote communities of the Northern Territory are living longer thanks to Aboriginal community-controlled healthcare. Health groups say more work is still needed to close the gap with the wider population. Both federal and territory governments are being urged to continue supporting these programs.

items.title_en: Aboriginal healthcare improves life expectancy in Northern Territory

items.raw_excerpt: Filmmaker Paul Smart shot his version of Don Quixote, "Don Barry: A Quixotic Exploration," in Guanajuato, despite knowing little Spanish.
items.summary_en: Filmmaker Paul Smart shot his version of Don Quixote in Guanajuato, Mexico. He made the film 'Don Barry: A Quixotic Exploration' despite knowing little Spanish. The colorful colonial city became the perfect backdrop for his quixotic project.

items.raw_excerpt: Conheça o ranking dos bairros de Curitiba onde é mais fácil viver sem carro. Bigorrilho e Mercês lideram o índice de caminhabilidade e valorização.
items.summary_en: A new ranking shows which neighborhoods in Curitiba, Brazil are easiest to live in without a car. Bigorrilho and Mercês lead the city's walkability index. The study highlights areas where residents can rely on walking instead of driving.

items.raw_excerpt: Kiki Leigh sempre gostou da vida em Los Angeles, mas o ritmo da cidade começou a pesar. Em 2024, durante…
items.summary_en: Kiki Leigh loved living in Los Angeles but the city's pace began to wear her down. In 2024 she discovered a dream home in a medieval Portuguese village and decided to move there. The story shows how one woman found a new life in a quiet, historic place.

items.raw_excerpt: Spanish police have recovered 29 axolotls, a critically endangered amphibian that survives in the wild only in the canals of Xochimilco.
items.summary_en: Spanish police seized 29 axolotls that were being smuggled. The axolotls are a critically endangered species found only in the canals of Xochimilco, Mexico. The animals were recovered during an operation against wildlife trafficking.

items.raw_excerpt: Former professional footballer Ricky Henderson is suing the AFL and Fox Sports for more than $1.2 million in damages over an incident in which "compromising footage" of him was aired on live television in 2013.
items.summary_en: Former professional footballer Ricky Henderson is suing the AFL and Fox Sports for over 1.2 million Australian dollars in damages. He claims compromising footage of him was shown on live television in 2013, causing him personal embarrassment. The lawsuit targets both the league and the broadcaster for the incident.
